ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jun-21-2012 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 514, Judge: Ellen Chaitin, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Sonia Wong #11288

Robert Kawamoto, Esq. for and with the Petitioner Ji Yung Yang, present as guardian ad litem for the minors Ellilyh Yeom and Ellianah Yeom, was placed under oath and examined.
Order waiving personal service on Minor's Father Peter Yeom aka Soon Yong Yeom was granted in open court.
Proof of Publication is in the file.

No objections to the proposed change of name of the minors were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of the minors to Ellilyh Yang and Ellianah Yang.
Decree Changing Name of the minors was submitted to and signed by the Court.
